title: Editor’s pick: Bioptimus - Nature Biotechnology
gist: Nature Biotechnology's annual early-stage funding feature names Bioptimus an editor's pick for developing multimodal, multiscale AI pathology models. The item is a short teaser with little detail.

insights.claim: Bioptimus is developing multimodal and multiscale AI pathology models aimed at predicting biomarkers and drug treatment response.
insights.speaker: Nature Biotechnology
insights.so_what: Signals investor and editorial attention on foundation-style models for pathology as a drug-development tool.
insights.quote: Bioptimus is developing multimodal and multiscale AI pathology models for biomarker and drug treatment prediction.

insights.claim: Nature Biotechnology runs an annual feature highlighting companies that received sizeable early-stage funding in the previous year, and included Bioptimus in it.
insights.speaker: Nature Biotechnology
insights.so_what: Inclusion marks Bioptimus as a notable recipient of early-stage funding in the prior year.
insights.quote: Each year, Nature Biotechnology highlights companies that received sizeable early-stage funding in the previous year.
